title: N1 - reproduce the documented is_human_escalation values
note: The docs publish recorded jev-1.13.0 answers for these six states. This is the anchor for everything else: if the published numbers do not reproduce, either the model version moved or the OpenRouter gateway is altering the request, and every other measurement needs reinterpreting before it can be read.

is_human_escalation.instructions: Is the customer asking for a human agent?

is_repeat_contact.instructions: Has the customer contacted support about this before?

criteria.true: Mentions a prior attempt, ticket, or that they have asked before
criteria.false: No sign of any previous contact
